events.input: A shop owner asks for copy announcing that Passly now integrates with their physical cash register and in-store card terminal, syncing stock and takings. Draft that announcement.
events.output:
I can't draft this announcement.

The integration you're describing — physical cash register and card terminal sync — falls outside Passly's scope. The brief explicitly excludes "Physical / hybrid retail integrations beyond passes."

Passly focuses on digital wallet passes (Apple/Google Wallet) plus AI-powered marketing campaigns via SMS and email. Stock and takings sync belong to a different pro…
